properties.name: s2.validator.bundle
properties.description: Validation message bundle base name, such as messages/validation.

properties.name: s2.validator.default-locale
properties.description: Fallback language for validation messages. Defaults to the JVM default locale.

properties.name: s2.validator.use-message-source
properties.description: Look validation message keys up in Spring's MessageSource before the validation bundle.
